description: This file implements PHP session management using ADODB database abstraction, specifically storing session data in Oracle CLOBs. It contains code for opening, reading, writing, destroying, and garbage collecting sessions, along with configuration and setup instructions.

methods.name: adodb_sess_open
methods.description: Establishes a persistent or non-persistent connection to the database for session management.

methods.name: adodb_sess_close
methods.description: Closes the current database connection used for sessions.

methods.name: adodb_sess_read
methods.description: Retrieves session data for a given session key from the database.

methods.name: adodb_sess_write
methods.description: Stores session data into the database, updating existing records or inserting new ones.

methods.name: adodb_sess_destroy
methods.description: Deletes a session record from the database, optionally invoking expiration notifications.

methods.name: adodb_sess_gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection to remove expired sessions from the database.
